messages:
Elaine: Quick proposal — we need a more forgiving way to negotiate MVP vs v1 without re-scoping mid-sprint. Sketch: a 'milestone ladder' with 3 checkpoints and explicit gating criteria.
Sam: can you separate which customer asks block launch vs which are post-launch? customers already asking for embeddings and SSO.
Elaine: yep. rough mapping below (iterate welcome):
```
MILESTONE A (Launch - MVP): core text gen API, basic auth, single-tenant defaults, prompt templates
MILESTONE B (Post-launch 0-6w): embeddings pilot behind flag, skeleton telemetry dashboard, caching tweaks
MILESTONE C (v1 6-12w): SSO, multi-tenant routing, Dedicated/reserved infra, QA/regressions expanded
Gating: no critical regressions on top 5 customer prompts; P50 < 200ms for core API; admin+audit for v1 infra features
```
Vik: engineer view: SSO + multi-tenant routing is a bundled 4-6w. If we push that to v1 we free ~3w for launch polish. embeddings as opt-in flag works. cc @Lina for flag UX.
Lina: design: can ship core flows with a simple telemetry page (counters, status links). full analytics as v1. need microcopy for feature flags and tenant UX.
Jamal: infra: Dedicated needs capacity commit + infra automation (~2-3w). don't promise Dedicated at launch unless we move capacity from pilots. watch burst costs.
Sam: prioritization rule idea: legal/security or sales-blocking customer asks -> escalate to v1 gating review. everything else -> Post-launch. keeps MVP tight.
Elaine: decision ask: by EOD commit to milestone ladder and move SSO + multi-tenant to v1; keep embeddings in Post-launch opt-in. react :thumbsup: to agree or reply with blockers.
Vik: :thumbsup: but note: moving SSO to v1 requires strict feature-flagging for pilot tenants. I'll add a dev checklist.
Lina: :thumbsup: will draft microcopy.
Jamal: :thumbsup: pending infra finance approval (ticket #INF-432 opened).
Sam: I'll update the roadmap and release checklist after closure. also propose a simple roll-forward fallback if Post-launch slips: revert to single-tenant + rate-limit heavy routes.
product-ops-bot: Decision doc created: https://company.docs/repo/milestone-ladder/1910202020 — labels: "mvp-decision", "milestone-ladder".
Elaine: thanks all — I'll consolidate notes and ping stakeholders. Drop blockers here before 5pm.
